title: Features Not Working Reliably
summary: This topic centers on owners describing features or functions that fail to work consistently, though most sampled fragments are too vague to identify the exact system involved.

positive.summary: One positive review expresses general enjoyment of the car rather than a clearly working feature tied to this topic.

negative.summary: Negative reviews specifically report features or in-vehicle functions that do not work at all, do not work every time, or basically fail in use.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mention something not working, needing a restart, or behaving inconsistently, but the fragments usually lack enough context to identify the feature or clear sentiment beyond the malfunction reference.

limitations: Most sampled fragments are short and vague, so the affected feature is often unclear.
The positive example is generic enjoyment language and is only loosely connected to this topic.
This cluster may combine multiple unrelated systems or features under broad wording about things not working.
